data.body:
rebar-debug Phase 1 RCA (fast path, confirmed).

Mechanism: `_candidate_dicts` adds an exact JSON reply twice — once from `_all_json_objects(text)` and once from whole-text `json.loads(text)` (`src/rebar/llm/structured.py:483-499`). `_select_and_validate` constructs a new Pydantic instance for each dict, then treats non-identity (`is not`) as semantic conflict (`:547-558`). Runtime probe on `{"verdict":"PASS"}` observed candidate_count=2, decoded equality true, validated equality true, identity false. This fully explains identical first/last warnings from native structured outputs and rules out model text, provider envelope, and retry aggregation.

Legitimacy: defect. The documented contract warns only when multiple candidates differ and preserves last-valid-wins for a model draft/correction; parser-created equal duplicates are not ambiguity. Existing `test_selection_last_valid_wins_and_warns_when_two_validate` is the authority for genuine conflict.

Expected post-fix behavior: semantically equal decoded candidates collapse in discovery order before validation; genuinely different valid candidates remain ordered, select the last, and warn. Caller sweep: `parse_structured` is the shared deterministic boundary used by Pydantic-AI output adapters and all review/verification schemas; callers depend on validated result/exception, not duplicate validation count. No behavioral dependency on false identical warnings. Phase 2 is unlocked after signed plan review.
